theorem cor_12_2_5 {x δ₀ Q₀ : ℝ} {a : ℕ → ℂ} (ha : PrimeSupported x a)
    (hQ₀ : 1e5 ≤ Q₀) (hδ₀ : 2 ≤ δ₀) (hx : (20000 * Q₀) ^ 2 ≤ x / (2 * δ₀))
    (hρ : 2 * Q₀ ≤ (2 * √(x / (2 * δ₀))) ^ (0.6 : ℝ)) :
    ∫ α in Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ majorArcs δ₀ Q₀ x, ‖expTsum a α‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (Real.log (2 * Q₀) + 2) / (Real.log (2 * √(x / (2 * δ₀))) + cE) * ∑' n, ‖a n‖ ^ 2 :=
